description: List deals (opportunities) in the person's ShearQuery Pipelines, grouped by stage — one pipeline's board, or a search across all of them by name, contact, email, phone, company or source. Filter by stage and status (open, won, lost, abandoned, all; default open). Returns each deal's id for the other crm_ tools.

pipeline.description: Pipeline name or id. Leave out to search all pipelines.

query.description: Search text: deal name, contact, email, phone, company or source.

name: crm_opportunities
title: Deals in my pipelines
